reasons: The cited Section 15 contains only an exclusive-remedy/consequential-damages exclusion and a Sections 13/14 carve-out — there is no monetary cap, so it fails the fallback's requirement of a mutual cap of twelve months' fees (and leaves Customer's direct liability open-ended), making the deviation classification correct rather than over-flagging an acceptable fallback.

The redline edits the existing paragraph rather than rewriting the section: it inserts the model mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000), the Excluded Claims carve-out set (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and the payment-obligations-are-not-damages clarification, while preserving the pre-existing Section 13/14 carve-out and the mutual indirect-damages exclusion.

Directionality is correct for the Customer side: the cap is mutual and the fee basis is the licence/maintenance fee stream (not an illusory set-up fee), and no unlimited-Customer-liability language remains.

The failed minimal-edit heuristic is explained by the necessary insertion of two substantive sentences into a short paragraph; the underlying original wording is left intact, so the edit is still the smallest that reaches the playbook position.
The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states the playbook position and offers the straight 12-months'-fees fallback.
